projectManagement.intro.en: Removing a project takes it out of the sidebar and the project picker. Its sessions stay in Recent and search, and nothing on disk is touched.
projectManagement.intro.zh: 移除项目只会把它从侧栏和项目选择器中拿掉。会话仍保留在最近和搜索中，磁盘上的文件不受影响。

projectManagement.search.zh: 搜索项目、文件夹或设备

projectManagement.unremovable.en: This project can’t be removed here
projectManagement.unremovable.zh: 此项目无法在这里移除

projectManagement.confirm.description.en: They leave the sidebar and the project picker. Their sessions ({sessions}) stay in Recent and search. Folders on disk are not touched.
projectManagement.confirm.description.zh: 它们会从侧栏和项目选择器中移除，其中的会话（{sessions} 个）仍保留在最近和搜索中，磁盘上的文件夹不受影响。

projectManagement.confirm.remoteNote.en: Removed from this computer only. They stay on {device} for its other clients.
projectManagement.confirm.remoteNote.zh: 只从本机移除，{device} 上的项目及其他客户端不受影响。

projectManagement.confirm.remoteNoteOne.en: Removed from this computer only. It stays on {device} for its other clients.
projectManagement.confirm.remoteNoteOne.zh: 只从本机移除，{device} 上的项目及其他客户端不受影响。

projectManagement.confirm.restoreLocal.en: Projects on this computer can be restored later from Removed projects on this page.
projectManagement.confirm.restoreLocal.zh: 本机项目之后可在本页的「已移除的项目」中恢复。

projectManagement.confirm.restoreRemote.en: To bring back a remote project later, add it again from its device.
projectManagement.confirm.restoreRemote.zh: 远程项目之后可从对应设备重新添加。

projectManagement.confirm.data.option.zh: 同时删除它们的 ZCode 数据

projectManagement.confirm.data.optionOne.zh: 同时删除它的 ZCode 数据

projectManagement.confirm.data.note.en: Sessions, session files, checkpoints and memory of the {count} projects on this computer.
projectManagement.confirm.data.note.zh: 这 {count} 个本机项目的会话、会话文件、检查点和记忆。

projectManagement.confirm.data.noteOne.en: Sessions, session files, checkpoints and memory of the project on this computer.
projectManagement.confirm.data.noteOne.zh: 这个本机项目的会话、会话文件、检查点和记忆。

projectManagement.confirm.data.notDelete.en: Not deleted: your folders and app logs.
projectManagement.confirm.data.notDelete.zh: 不会删除：你的文件夹和应用日志。

projectManagement.confirm.data.notDelete.en: Not deleted: your folders, app logs, and data on {devices}.
projectManagement.confirm.data.notDelete.zh: 不会删除：你的文件夹、应用日志，以及 {devices} 上的数据。

projectManagement.confirm.data.title.en: Remove {count} projects and delete their data?
projectManagement.confirm.data.title.zh: 移除 {count} 个项目并删除其数据？

projectManagement.confirm.data.titleOne.en: Remove 1 project and delete its data?
projectManagement.confirm.data.titleOne.zh: 移除 1 个项目并删除其数据？

projectManagement.confirm.data.descripti.en: They leave the sidebar and the project picker. The {sessions} of the {count} projects on this computer are deleted with their files. Folders on disk are not touched.
projectManagement.confirm.data.descripti.zh: 它们会离开侧栏和项目选择器。这 {count} 个本机项目的 {sessions}会连同文件一起删除。磁盘上的文件夹不受影响。

projectManagement.confirm.data.descripti.en: They leave the sidebar and the project picker. The {sessions} of the project on this computer are deleted with their files. Folders on disk are not touched.
projectManagement.confirm.data.descripti.zh: 它们会离开侧栏和项目选择器。这个本机项目的 {sessions}会连同文件一起删除。磁盘上的文件夹不受影响。

projectManagement.confirm.data.noRestore.en: The {count} projects on this computer can’t be restored afterwards.
projectManagement.confirm.data.noRestore.zh: 这 {count} 个本机项目之后无法恢复。

projectManagement.confirm.data.noRestore.en: The project on this computer can’t be restored afterwards.
projectManagement.confirm.data.noRestore.zh: 这个本机项目之后无法恢复。

projectManagement.data.progress.zh: 正在删除 {count} 个项目的数据…

projectManagement.data.progressOne.zh: 正在删除 1 个项目的数据…

projectManagement.data.removedToast.zh: 已移除 {count} 个项目 · 释放 {size}

projectManagement.data.removedToastOne.zh: 已移除 1 个项目 · 释放 {size}

projectManagement.data.deletedToast.en: Deleted the data of {count} projects · freed {size}
projectManagement.data.deletedToast.zh: 已删除 {count} 个项目的数据 · 释放 {size}

projectManagement.data.deletedToastOne.en: Deleted the data of 1 project · freed {size}
projectManagement.data.deletedToastOne.zh: 已删除 1 个项目的数据 · 释放 {size}

projectManagement.failure.purge.en: The data of {count} projects wasn’t deleted: {name} — {reason}
projectManagement.failure.purge.zh: {count} 个项目的数据未能删除：{name}（{reason}）

projectManagement.failure.purgeOne.en: The data of 1 project wasn’t deleted: {name} — {reason}
projectManagement.failure.purgeOne.zh: 1 个项目的数据未能删除：{name}（{reason}）

projectManagement.noUnused.zh: 目前没有疑似不再使用的项目

project.dataSessionRunning.en: a session is still running; try again when it finishes
project.dataSessionRunning.zh: 仍有会话在运行，结束后再试

project.dataSessionReferenced.en: a fork in another project still uses the attachments of a session, so that session was kept
project.dataSessionReferenced.zh: 有会话的附件仍被其他项目中的分叉会话使用，已保留该会话

project.dataUnavailable.en: this version of the agent can’t delete project data
project.dataUnavailable.zh: 当前 Agent 版本不支持删除项目数据

project.undoUnavailable.en: This entry has no project identity, so it can’t be added back automatically.
project.undoUnavailable.zh: 该入口缺少项目身份，无法自动重新添加。

remote.downgradeConfirmDescription.en: The remote ZCode service will switch from {current} to {version}, the same version as this desktop app. Devices that still use the newer desktop app must update the remote again when they connect. The older version may not fully show content that the newer version wrote.
remote.downgradeConfirmDescription.zh: 远端 ZCode 服务将从 {current} 切换到与本机桌面端相同的 {version}。仍在使用新版本桌面端的设备连接时，需要再次更新远端。旧版本可能无法完整显示新版本写入的内容。

remote.downgradedHint.en: An older desktop app switched this remote from {from} to the current version. The remote updates only after you confirm.
remote.downgradedHint.zh: 该远端已由旧版桌面端从 {from} 切换到当前版本。确认后才会更新远端。

remote.error.sourceServerDowngradeUnconf.en: Reconnect to read the latest version of the remote device.
remote.error.sourceServerDowngradeUnconf.zh: 请重新连接，读取远端的最新版本。

remote.error.sourceServerStopFailed.reas.en: The remote service didn't exit cleanly. Try again later, or sign in to the device to check it.
remote.error.sourceServerStopFailed.reas.zh: 远端服务没有正常退出。请稍后重试；仍失败时请登录这台设备检查。

remote.error.sourceServerControlUnrespon.en: The remote service didn't answer the request. Sign in to the device to check it, then try again.
remote.error.sourceServerControlUnrespon.zh: 远端服务没有响应请求。请登录这台设备检查后重试。

sidePane.launcher.sites.zh: 查看站点、部署记录和用量。

fileActions.saveAsUnavailable.zh: 当前环境不支持保存文件

fileActions.saveAsFailed.en: Could not save this file. Check the source connection and try again.
fileActions.saveAsFailed.zh: 文件保存失败，请检查来源连接后重试。

fileActions.saveAsTooLarge.en: Files larger than 50 MiB cannot be saved here.
fileActions.saveAsTooLarge.zh: 暂不支持另存超过 50 MiB 的文件。

remote.error.sourceServerDowngradeUnconf.en: The remote device was updated to a newer version. This operation did not downgrade it.
remote.error.sourceServerDowngradeUnconf.zh: 远程设备已更新到更高版本，本次操作没有降级远端。

settings.source.reinstallRemoteServiceHi.en: Uses this computer's version. Projects and tasks are kept.
settings.source.reinstallRemoteServiceHi.zh: 用本机版本重新安装，保留项目和任务

settings.source.reinstallRemoteServiceDe.en: ZCode Server {version} will be reinstalled on {source}. Damaged program files are replaced. Projects, tasks, settings, and sign-in information are kept.
settings.source.reinstallRemoteServiceDe.zh: 将在 {source} 上重新安装 ZCode Server {version}。损坏的程序文件会被替换，项目、任务、设置和登录信息都会保留。

settings.source.remoteServiceInterruptio.en: This interrupts all running tasks on this device. They won't resume automatically.
settings.source.remoteServiceInterruptio.zh: 这会中断此设备上所有运行中的任务，这些任务不会自动续跑。

settings.source.remoteServiceRunningTask.en: The device didn't provide a task list.

settings.source.remoteServiceNoRunningTa.en: No tasks are running on this device right now.
settings.source.remoteServiceNoRunningTa.zh: 此设备当前没有运行中的任务。

settings.source.remoteServiceOtherClient.en: If ZCode on another computer is connected to this device, it may start the remote service again.
settings.source.remoteServiceOtherClient.zh: 其他电脑上的 ZCode 若连着这台设备，可能会重新启动远端服务。

settings.source.stopRemoteServiceStartup.en: “Reconnect automatically at startup” is on, so the remote service will start again the next time you open ZCode.
settings.source.stopRemoteServiceStartup.zh: 「启动时自动重连」已开启，下次打开 ZCode 时会重新启动远端服务。

settings.source.remoteServiceUpdateRequi.en: Available after updating the remote service

settings.source.error.credentials-requir.en: Couldn't get the SSH credentials automatically. Connect to this device once first.
settings.source.error.credentials-requir.zh: 无法自动取得 SSH 凭据，请先连接一次此设备。

settings.source.error.source-server-stop.en: The remote service didn't stop. Try again later, or sign in to the device to check it.
settings.source.error.source-server-stop.zh: 远端服务未能停止。请稍后重试；仍失败时请登录这台设备检查。

settings.source.error.source-server-cont.en: The remote service isn't responding. Sign in to the device to check it, then try again.
settings.source.error.source-server-cont.zh: 远端服务无响应。请登录这台设备检查后重试。

settings.source.error.source-server-oper.en: Another operation is in progress on this device. Try again later.
settings.source.error.source-server-oper.zh: 此设备有其他操作正在进行，请稍后再试。

settings.source.searchPlaceholder.zh: 搜索设备名、地址或项目

settings.source.hideProjectDeviceNames.en: Hide device names in project rows

settings.source.hideProjectDeviceNamesDe.en: Hide remote device names in task list project rows. Hover to view them.
settings.source.hideProjectDeviceNamesDe.zh: 在任务列表的项目行中隐藏远程设备名，悬停仍可查看。

sourceServer.reinstallCompletedToast.zh: {source} 已重新安装并重新连接。

sourceServer.reinstallFailedToast.en: {source} could not be reinstalled. Review the log under Remote devices and try again.
sourceServer.reinstallFailedToast.zh: {source} 重新安装失败，请在远程设备中查看日志并重试。

sourceServer.stopCompletedToast.zh: 已停止 {source} 的远端服务。

sourceServer.stopFailedToast.en: Couldn't stop the remote service on {source}. View details.
sourceServer.stopFailedToast.zh: 未能停止 {source} 的远端服务，请查看详情。

sourceServer.restartCompletedToast.en: Restarted the remote service on {source} and reconnected.
sourceServer.restartCompletedToast.zh: 已重启 {source} 的远端服务并重新连接。

sourceServer.restartFailedToast.en: Couldn't restart the remote service on {source}. View details.
sourceServer.restartFailedToast.zh: 未能重启 {source} 的远端服务，请查看详情。

chat.workspaceMcpPending.message.en: {count} workspace MCP server(s) await trust. Trust changes apply to new or restarted chats; you can continue chatting.
chat.workspaceMcpPending.message.zh: {count} 个工作区 MCP 待信任。信任变更在新建或重启会话时生效，聊天可继续。

taskList.restartUnsupported.en: This Agent version does not support restarting tasks. Update it first.
taskList.restartUnsupported.zh: 当前 Agent 版本不支持重启任务，请先更新。

taskList.recoverWorkspaceDescription.en: Task resources could not be safely released. Continuing stops every task sharing this Agent process, including tasks in other workspaces. Conversation history is kept.
taskList.recoverWorkspaceDescription.zh: 任务资源未能安全释放。继续会中断所有共用此 Agent 进程的任务，包括其他工作区的任务。会话历史会保留。

taskList.restartFailed.en: Restart failed. Check the task status and try again.
taskList.restartFailed.zh: 重启失败，请查看任务状态后重试

chat.slash.app.reload.description.en: Reload the task runtime, preserving history and stopping current execution.
chat.slash.app.reload.description.zh: Reload the task runtime, preserving history and stopping current execution.

settings.personalization.description.en: Add custom instructions to personalize Agent responses. Instructions apply to future conversations of the local Agent; remote devices need separate configuration.
settings.personalization.description.zh: 添加自定义指令来个性化 Agent 的回复，指令会应用到你本机 Agent 的后续会话；远程设备需单独配置。

settings.personalization.saveFailed.en: Failed to save. Check the logs

settings.personalization.loadFailed.en: Failed to load custom instructions. Check the logs
settings.personalization.loadFailed.zh: 读取个性化指令失败，请查看日志

settings.personalization.localOnly.en: Custom instructions can only be edited on the local desktop. Open Settings → Personalization in the desktop app.
settings.personalization.localOnly.zh: 个性化指令仅支持在本地桌面端设置，请前往本地桌面端的“个性化”设置。

settings.personalization.sizeOverLimit.en: Content exceeds the 100 KB limit the Agent reads; anything beyond it is ignored. Trim before saving.
settings.personalization.sizeOverLimit.zh: 内容超出 Agent 读取上限 100 KB，超出部分不会生效；请精简后再保存。

settings.mcp.trust.revokeTitle.zh: 撤销工作区 MCP 信任：{name}

settings.mcp.trust.description.en: Connections may run code or send data. Trust does not enable MCP. Existing chats keep their authorization. Changes apply to new or restarted chats.
settings.mcp.trust.description.zh: 连接可运行本地命令或发送数据。信任不会启用 MCP。已有会话沿用原授权，信任变更在新建或重启会话时生效。

settings.mcp.trust.failed.en: The declaration changed or trust is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
settings.mcp.trust.failed.zh: 声明已变化或信任服务不可用，请刷新后重试。

settings.scope.deviceOffline.en: {device} is offline. Its configuration cannot be read or changed until it reconnects.
settings.scope.deviceOffline.zh: 「{device}」已离线，无法读取或修改它的配置。设备重新连接后再试。

settings.plugins.marketplaces.riskWarnin.en: Unofficial plugin marketplaces may contain malicious plugins that can harm your device. Verify the source and take precautions before adding.
settings.plugins.marketplaces.riskWarnin.zh: 非官方插件市场可能包含恶意插件，损害设备。请先核实来源并做好风险防范，再添加。

settings.plugins.marketplaces.riskAcknow.en: I understand the risks, have verified the source, and have taken precautions.
settings.plugins.marketplaces.riskAcknow.zh: 我已了解风险，并已核实来源、做好风险防范。

settings.plugins.updateAll.partial.zh: 已更新 {succeeded} 个，{failed} 个失败：{plugins}

settings.plugins.updateAll.aborted.en: Update all stopped because the plugin scope changed; updated {count} plugin(s)
settings.plugins.updateAll.aborted.zh: 插件范围已切换，全部更新已中止；已更新 {count} 个插件

onboarding.finish.workspaceRequired.en: {count} items need a project and were not imported. Open a project, then migrate them again.
onboarding.finish.workspaceRequired.zh: {count} 项需要导入到项目，请先打开项目后再迁移这些项。

imageEditor.saveFailed.en: Could not save the image. Try again.

imageEditor.noComposer.en: No chat input is available for this image
imageEditor.noComposer.zh: 当前没有可接收图片的输入框

mode.yoloConfirmation.description.en: Tasks can perform the following actions without asking for your approval each time.
mode.yoloConfirmation.description.zh: 启用后，任务可以直接执行以下操作，无需逐次请求你确认。

mode.yoloConfirmation.files.description.en: Read, create, change, and delete accessible files.
mode.yoloConfirmation.files.description.zh: 读取、创建、修改和删除可访问的文件。

mode.yoloConfirmation.commands.descripti.en: Run commands, install software, or change system settings.
mode.yoloConfirmation.commands.descripti.zh: 运行命令、安装软件或修改系统配置。

mode.yoloConfirmation.network.descriptio.en: Access the network, send data, and use connected apps.
mode.yoloConfirmation.network.descriptio.zh: 访问网络、发送数据，以及调用已连接的应用。

mode.yoloConfirmation.risk.en: These actions may cause data loss or disclosure. Enable only for tasks you trust. You can switch to another permission mode at any time.
mode.yoloConfirmation.risk.zh: 这些操作可能造成数据丢失或泄露。请仅在信任任务内容时启用。你可以随时切回其他权限模式。

mode.yoloConfirmation.acknowledgement.en: I understand the risks and take responsibility for my data security.
mode.yoloConfirmation.acknowledgement.zh: 我已了解风险，并对自己的数据安全负责。

zcode.error.providerBusiness.3106.en: This run exceeded the maximum single-run time. Create a new idle-time task to continue.
zcode.error.providerBusiness.3106.zh: 已超过单次最长运行时间，请创建新的闲时任务继续。

zcode.error.offPeakTicketExpired.en: This idle-time task can no longer continue. Create a new idle-time task.
zcode.error.offPeakTicketExpired.zh: 此闲时任务已无法继续，请创建新的闲时任务。

remoteSync.description.en: Sync local configuration to remote devices.

remoteSync.rules.description.en: Only adds or updates items. Remote-only content is preserved.
remoteSync.rules.description.zh: 仅新增或更新，保留远端独有内容。

remoteSync.empty.description.en: Connect an SSH, WSL, or Docker device to push this device's configuration to its ~/.zcode directory.
remoteSync.empty.description.zh: 连接 SSH、WSL 或 Docker 设备后，可以把本机配置推送到该设备的 ~/.zcode 目录。

remoteSync.dialog.offline.en: The device is offline, so actions are disabled. The list refreshes automatically when the device is back online.
remoteSync.dialog.offline.zh: 设备已离线，操作已禁用。设备重新上线后会自动刷新列表。

remoteSync.category.empty.en: No items on this device to sync
remoteSync.category.empty.zh: 本机没有可同步的条目

remoteSync.overview.description.en: Review configuration differences between this device and the target.
remoteSync.overview.description.zh: 查看本机与目标设备之间的配置差异。

remoteSync.blocked.sizeLimit.en: Exceeds the size limit and cannot be synced
remoteSync.blocked.sizeLimit.zh: 超过大小上限，不能同步

remoteSync.blocked.containsSymlink.en: Contains a symbolic link and cannot be synced
remoteSync.blocked.containsSymlink.zh: 目录内含软链，不能同步

remoteSync.blocked.targetSymlink.en: The remote item is a symbolic link and cannot be overwritten
remoteSync.blocked.targetSymlink.zh: 远端同名项是软链，不能覆盖

remoteSync.blocked.compatDirectory.en: The remote item is in the ~/.agents compatibility directory and cannot be overwritten
remoteSync.blocked.compatDirectory.zh: 远端同名项位于 ~/.agents 兼容目录，不能覆盖

remoteSync.blocked.externalDirectory.en: The remote plugin with the same name is outside ~/.zcode/plugins (for example a development checkout) and cannot be updated
remoteSync.blocked.externalDirectory.zh: 远端同名插件位于 ~/.zcode/plugins 以外的目录（例如开发中的 checkout），不能更新

remoteSync.blocked.targetCompatConfig.en: The remote device uses the ~/.agents compatibility config; pushing would disable it
remoteSync.blocked.targetCompatConfig.zh: 远端使用 ~/.agents 兼容配置，推送会使其失效

remoteSync.blocked.sourceRemoved.en: The source was removed and cannot be synced

remoteSync.blocked.remoteLatestMismatch.en: The latest version from the remote source differs from the version on this device
remoteSync.blocked.remoteLatestMismatch.zh: 远端来源的最新版本与本机不一致

remoteSync.blocked.crossMarketplaceDepen.en: Depends on a plugin from another marketplace. Mirroring does not support cross-marketplace dependencies
remoteSync.blocked.crossMarketplaceDepen.zh: 依赖其他 marketplace 的插件，镜像不支持跨 marketplace 的依赖

remoteSync.blocked.unsupportedSource.en: This source type cannot be synced

remoteSync.item.conflict.en: The remote item changed. Refresh and try again.
remoteSync.item.conflict.zh: 远端已变化，请刷新后重试

remoteSync.error.offline.en: The device disconnected during the push. The push did not finish.
remoteSync.error.offline.zh: 推送中设备已断开，本次推送未完成。

remoteSync.error.preflightTimeout.en: Checking remote write access timed out. Nothing was written.
remoteSync.error.preflightTimeout.zh: 检查远端写入权限超时，未写入任何内容。

remoteSync.category.providers.warning.en: This device's model configuration is the source of truth and syncs to the remote automatically after you save. API keys and sign-in state sync with it.
remoteSync.category.providers.warning.zh: 模型配置以本机为准，保存后自动同步到远端；API Key 和登录态随配置同步

remoteSync.providers.empty.en: No custom model providers on this device
remoteSync.providers.empty.zh: 本机没有自定义的模型提供商

remoteSync.providers.status.noLane.en: Syncs automatically after you open a project on this device
remoteSync.providers.status.noLane.zh: 打开该设备上的项目后自动同步

remoteSync.providers.status.loadFailed.en: Could not read the automatic sync status
remoteSync.providers.status.loadFailed.zh: 无法读取自动同步状态

remoteSync.providers.error.sourceReadFai.en: Could not read the local model configuration
remoteSync.providers.error.sourceReadFai.zh: 读取本机模型配置失败

remoteSync.providers.error.targetCallFai.en: Could not reach the remote sync service
remoteSync.providers.error.targetCallFai.zh: 无法调用远端的同步服务

remoteSync.providers.error.targetWriteFa.en: The remote device could not write the configuration

remoteSync.providers.error.targetRefresh.en: The remote device could not reload the model configuration
remoteSync.providers.error.targetRefresh.zh: 远端刷新模型配置失败

remoteSync.providers.error.targetCommitF.en: The remote device could not record the sync result
remoteSync.providers.error.targetCommitF.zh: 远端记录同步结果失败

remoteSync.providers.error.targetApplyFa.en: The remote device could not apply the configuration

remoteSync.providers.error.capabilityUna.en: The remote version does not support model configuration sync
remoteSync.providers.error.capabilityUna.zh: 远端版本不支持模型配置同步

remoteSync.providers.error.sessionUnavai.en: The remote connection is no longer available

remoteSync.providers.error.hostExecution.en: The sync could not run on this device

chat.configReadRetryStatus.zh: 正在重新读取请求校验配置（{attempt}/{maxRetries}）…

chat.configReadFailed.zh: 暂时无法读取请求校验配置，消息尚未发送。请检查网络后重试。

chat.configInvalid.zh: 请求校验配置无效，请检查账号或联系支持。
